status_summary: H.R. 2870, the Working Families Flexibility Act of 2025, was introduced on 2025-04-10. The House Education and Workforce Committee ordered it reported as amended on 2025-11-20 by a vote of 19 to 15 and reported it on 2026-02-12 (H. Rept. 119-496), placing it on the Union Calendar. As reported, the compensatory time authority would last five years from enactment. A Senate version was announced on 2025-03-28. No House floor vote was found.
